```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#containing purr, dplyr and ggplot 
pacman::p_load(tidyverse)
```

## Load the data
```{r}
path <- "~/Desktop/data"

files <- list.files(path, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

data_list <- list()

for (file in files) {
  data <- read.csv(file)
  data_list[[file]] <- data
}
```

## Checking variables 
```{r}
#using purrr to check class type of first column 
 map_chr(data_list, ~ class(.x[[1]]))

##first four datasets have "subject" column as character, last four has it as integer
```

```{r}
#changing "subject" column to be all characters
data_list <- map(data_list, function(df) {
  if (is.integer(df[[1]])) {
    df[[1]] <- as.character(df[[1]])
  }
  df
})

#check it took effect
map_chr(data_list, ~ class(.x[[1]]))
```

## Merging data 
```{r}
#merge dataframes in data_list
merged <- bind_rows(data_list)

#drop NA column 
merged = subset(merged, select = -c(X))
```

```{r}
# Aggregate data
agg_data <- merged %>%
  group_by(subjective_response) %>%
  summarise(avg_reaction_time = mean(objective_response_time_ms), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(agg_data, aes(x = subjective_response, y = avg_reaction_time)) +
  xlab("PAS score") +
  ylab("Reaction Time") +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  ggtitle("Reaction time between subjects across PAS scores")+
  theme_minimal()

```
